title.narrative: Teach For Ukraine: Mainstreaming Psychosocial Support in Ukraine’s Rural Schools
Teach For Ukraine: Mainstreaming Psychosocial Support in Ukraine’s Rural Schools

description.narrative: Teach For Ukraine's Project on Mainstreaming Psychosocial Support in Rural Schools is aimed at addressing the urgent need for mental health and well-being support for vulnerable children particularly affected by the war in Ukraine. The project will integrate psychosocial support into classrooms by equipping 600 teachers from rural schools with the necessary tools, benefiting almost 12,000 children. Additionally, Summer Academy and extracurricular activities will provide a secure environment for 150 children, reducing their stress and anxiety while developing their skills and knowledge. Psychosocial support training will be delivered on a school basis so that the whole teacher and principal community can benefit and build their collective capacity.
